extracted.stage: divorce financial proceedings, stage not stated
extracted.summary: A partner at Vance Solicitors LLP enquires about a £61,000 litigation loan for a husband in divorce proceedings where assets in dispute are around £572,500.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client. We have noted the request for £61,000 towards counsel, a forensic accountant and your firm's costs, with assets in dispute of approximately £572,500. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court, the current stage of proceedings and any listed hearing dates, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, and details of the assets in dispute including how they are held and any existing charges. We will also need your client's contact details and consent. Once we have these we can review the enquiry and come back to you.
